meta.name: scienceworld-conditional-placer
meta.description: Places an object into one of several designated containers based on a measured condition, such as a temperature threshold. Use this skill when you have completed a measurement or assessment and the task requires sorting or storing the object into one of multiple containers according to a rule (e.g., "if temperature > X, place in container A; otherwise container B").

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按测量条件将物体放入指定容器
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在实验中根据测量结果自动分拣物品
copy.tagline_en: Place objects into designated containers based on measured conditions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically sort items based on measurement results in experiments

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据测量结果（如温度、导电性）将物品放入正确的容器。它会自动执行获取工具、测量、分类的完整流程。
howto.when: 当你已经完成测量，或者要求基于某个条件（例如温度阈值）把物品分到多个容器之一时触发。

say.text: 把金属叉放到温度超过50度的橙色盒子里。
say.note: Claude 将执行测量并分类放置。

say.text: 测量这根铁棒的导电性，然后放到对应的篮子中。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can place an object into the correct container based on a measured condition (e.g., temperature, conductivity). It automates the full workflow: locate tool, measure, evaluate, and place.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have completed a measurement or need to sort an object into one of multiple containers based on a rule (e.g., temperature threshold).

say_en.text: Put the metal fork into the orange box if its temperature is above 50°C.
say_en.note: Claude will measure and place accordingly.

say_en.text: Measure the conductivity of this iron rod and place it in the correct basket.
say_en.note: If conductive, basket A; otherwise, basket B.
